name: Such a guy
storyline:
As summer arrives, Zane Zheng quits his urban job and heads to a seaside town to co-manage an old guesthouse with two friends. Starting from scratch, they face funding shortages, operational challenges, and personality clashes, gradually building a warm and authentic space. What begins as an entrepreneurial journey slowly turns into a journey of personal growth.

Meanwhile, six women with diverse personalities and backgrounds enter Zane Zheng’s life. They are travelers, neighbors, colleagues, and possibly destined partners. Every conversation choice, interaction timing, management preference, and even moments of silence influence relationships, shaping emotional outcomes and the narrative's conclusion.

Will the business succeed? How will relationships end? Which connection will last? The game hands you full control to experience a complete life story through authentic audiovisual storytelling.
summary:
Such A Guy is a first-person narrative game that blends live-action interactive storytelling with light management gameplay. You play as Zane Zheng, a young man who leaves his city job in search of meaning and, together with two close friends, renovates a lakeside guesthouse by the sea. Featuring cinematic-grade filming, real actors, and on-location shooting, the game offers a deeply immersive experience. It combines branching narratives, relationship development, and exploration to create a lifelike yet open-ended interactive journey.

With nearly 1,000 minutes of 4K HD footage at its core, the game incorporates a relationship system and branching events. Players face hundreds of decision points, each influencing the characters' fates and the progression of the story. Over 20 different endings are available, along with side mini-games, hidden surprises, memorable scenes, and an achievement system to encourage exploration and replayability.
